verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge with organizations, so requiring SAML single sign-on is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions SAML, SSO enforcement, or identity-provider integration. The only sign-in material covers GitHub-based sign-up, CLI browser login and personal access tokens, which are adjacent features and not organization-enforced SAML.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can require SAML single sign-on for my organization
